summary: Latency-sensitive first-finish testing of Spanish corporate portal. Backend: verified auth (admin/user/invalid), /auth/me, /apps role-scoping (admin=4, user=1), 403 on forbidden app, submission required-field validation with Spanish label, submit + list, admin CRUD (list/create/patch/delete), duplicate email 400, invalid role 422, self-delete 400, non-admin 403 on /api/admin/*. Frontend: admin login -> 4 app cards, clientes form submit shows in Registros tab, admin users page create+delete+edit dialog works, logout clears session (protected route redirects to /login), user login shows 1 card, no admin nav link, /admin/usuarios redirects to /portal.
passed: POST /api/auth/login admin returns token + user (role=admin, 4 allowed_apps)
GET /api/auth/me no token -> 401; with token returns admin profile
POST /api/apps/clientes/submissions missing empresa -> 400 with Spanish label 'El campo \'Empresa\' es obligatorio'
POST valid submission returns 200 with id; GET returns user's own submissions
GET /api/admin/users as admin=3 users; as user -> 403
POST /api/admin/users duplicate -> 400; invalid role -> 422; valid create returns user id
Frontend admin login -> /portal, apps-grid shows 4 cards
clientes form submit shows in submissions-table, tab-lista works
Admin nav visible; create user via dialog (Radix Select in Spanish 'Usuario') increases rows from 4->5
Delete with AlertDialog confirm reduces rows 5->4; edit dialog opens and cancels cleanly
Logout returns to /login; visiting /portal redirects to /login
user@portal.com sees 1 card, no nav-admin-users; /admin/usuarios redirects to /portal
notes: Role Select uses Spanish labels (Administrador/Editor/Usuario) — automation must click Radix trigger and pick Spanish option. Admin's own delete button is disabled in UI, preventing self-delete at UI layer in addition to API guard.
